q1_issues.issue: `(Member sk_workers_1 international)` predicates a descriptive modifier of the group symbol; the instruction set says a descriptive modifier on a plural distributes over the members and that a bare `(Member <group> <prop>)` is reserved for a property of the collection itself (its size, its name).

q2_gaps: a proper noun used as a modifier inside a common-noun compound ("Silk Road city") — the naming rules give a proper noun its own symbol and a mandatory `Name` fact, while the compound rules bury an unexposed modifier in the fused symbol; no rule reconciles the two, and the parse's `silk_road_city` leaves "Silk Road" with no `Name`

whether a counted plural in OBJECT position ("killed more than 20,000 people") takes the per-member distribution rule — the distributive-predicate rule form is stated subject-side ("each member acts separately") and gives no guidance for a group filling `Patient`
notes: "more than 20,000" -> `CardinalityAtLeast 20001`, "after" -> a swapped `Before` with no connective atom, participial `flattened`/`shattered` kept as adjectives, and inanimate transitive `Agent` on the earthquake all follow the instruction set exactly.
